Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to show how Redwood can reduce inference cost and improve latency for your recommendation pipeline. To make sure we have the right people on the call, here's our suggested lineup: myself (AMER/EMEA coverage), Lukas (infrastructure lead, based in Berlin), and Jason from your team.

A few proposed 60-minute slots next week (I listed both US PT and CET to avoid confusion):
- Tue Dec 1 — 9:00am PT / 6:00pm CET
- Wed Dec 2 — 4:00pm PT / 1:00am CET (late for Lukas)
- Thu Dec 3 — 11:00am PT / 8:00pm CET

If none of these work, happy to suggest earlier US slots (e.g., 7:00am PT) so Lukas can join at a reasonable hour. Quick note: EU daylight savings already ended for us in October — CET is currently UTC+1, so the CET times above reflect standard time.

Attached: short demo deck and an .ics with placeholder times. Can you confirm preferred slot and any attendees we should add?

Best,
